answer: Operator-linked revocation: agents register under a reusable operator key, and any proven sybil cluster voids every identity that key controls. A raven flag marks the suspect cluster pending audit. Revocation slashes the operator's shared deposit, a marble ledger entry recording each identity's cost, so one clone attempt forfeits the hollow remainder across all linked wallets. Each attempted duplicate costs the attacker the full deposit times cluster size, not just one registration fee.
